oneLineDescription: Greene & Tova is a boutique Toronto-based immigration law firm specializing in Canadian work permits, permanent residence, citizenship, and LMIA support for employers.

services.name: Canadian Work Permits
services.description: Assisting individuals and employers with obtaining Canadian work permits.

services.name: Permanent Residence Applications
services.description: Guiding individuals through the process of applying for Canadian permanent residence.

services.name: Citizenship Applications
services.description: Supporting clients with their applications for Canadian citizenship.

services.name: LMIA Support for Employers
services.description: Providing Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) support for employers hiring foreign workers.

services.name: Corporate Mobility Consulting
services.description: Facilitating the relocation of employees to Canada for mid-sized US and EU tech companies.

services.name: Individual Permanent Status Applications
services.description: Assisting individuals already in Canada on temporary visas to achieve permanent resident status.

targetAudience: Mid-sized US and EU tech companies relocating employees to Canada, and individuals in Canada on temporary visas seeking permanent status.
uniqueSellingPoints: Partners' in-house tech company experience provides employer-side understanding.
Weekly newsletter on Canadian immigration policy with 8,000 subscribers.
